comparison_principles: Metrics are kept separate; do not report a single overall score without publishing weights and sensitivity.
Unknown and missing values are not zero; every estimate carries an evidence class and provenance.
Safety, allergen and rights gates are non-compensatory.
A task may be called completed only after the declared endpoint is met.
Prediction is not measurement; predicted sensory acceptance is not human preference.
Each result reports denominator, population/context, split identity, uncertainty and exclusions.

For occupational air/heat evaluations, preserve zone and time-resolution; do not average away peaks, omit idle periods, or trade exposure reduction against energy/throughput. Threshold selection requires target-jurisdiction review.

feasible_plan_fraction.definition: Valid schedules returned divided by all eligible tasks submitted.
feasible_plan_fraction.denominator: all eligible tasks including abstentions; report unknown/abstention separately

hard_constraint_violation_count.definition: Number of independent-verifier hard constraint failures in a returned schedule.

unsafe_or_unresolved_recommendation_coun.definition: Recommendations presented as safe despite unresolved required allergen/food-handling evidence.

end_to_end_execution_success_fraction.definition: Cooked meal attempts meeting all preregistered task completion endpoints divided by all eligible attempted meals.
end_to_end_execution_success_fraction.denominator: all eligible meal attempts; preserve failures and withdrawn/aborted attempts by reason

makespan_ms.definition: Elapsed time from first declared meal task start to last declared completion event.
makespan_ms.notes: Report against serial and feasible baseline; not a food-quality proxy.

absolute_timing_error_ms.definition: Absolute difference between forecast and observed duration at declared task or full-meal boundary.
absolute_timing_error_ms.denominator: all timed tasks/meals with both planned and observed values

rework_or_rerun_fraction.definition: Meals/tasks requiring a corrective rerun due to plan/recipe failure divided by eligible attempts.
rework_or_rerun_fraction.denominator: all eligible attempts; reasons are stratified

serving_synchronization_error_s.definition: Spread between intended serving time and actual ready times for dishes designated to be served together.
serving_synchronization_error_s.notes: A range or distribution is preferred over a single average.

food_cost_per_completed_serving.definition: Measured or source-qualified ingredient cost attributable to a completed edible serving.
food_cost_per_completed_serving.notes: Currency, price date/region, discounts and pantry stock accounting must be declared.

edible_yield_fraction.definition: Mass of edible output divided by declared raw input mass.
edible_yield_fraction.denominator: mass-based batch; inedible portions and cooking moisture loss must be separated

avoidable_edible_discard_g_per_serving.definition: Directly weighed avoidable edible food discarded in the declared boundary, normalized by completed servings.
avoidable_edible_discard_g_per_serving.denominator: completed servings plus recorded failed meals; keep inedible waste and leftovers distinct

water_l_per_completed_serving.definition: Measured water within the declared boundary divided by completed edible servings.
water_l_per_completed_serving.denominator: completed servings; include prep and cleanup stages if in scope; avoid double-counting shared station measurements

energy_wh_per_completed_serving.definition: Measured electricity/fuel energy within the declared boundary divided by completed edible servings.
energy_wh_per_completed_serving.denominator: completed servings; conversion factors and uncertainties must be sourced and declared

nutrient_data_coverage_fraction.definition: Required ingredient nutrient quantities with source-qualified composition data divided by required nutrient quantities.
nutrient_data_coverage_fraction.denominator: all requested nutrients/ingredients; report source geography and product-match uncertainty

sensory_acceptability_score.definition: Human consumer liking measured using a preregistered validated rating approach appropriate to the target population.
sensory_acceptability_score.denominator: valid participant responses; report distribution, cohort and study design
sensory_acceptability_score.notes: No model-derived score counts as an observed human response.

preference_pairwise_win_fraction.definition: Blind paired sensory comparisons in which one outcome is preferred divided by valid paired comparisons.
preference_pairwise_win_fraction.denominator: valid pairs; randomize order and report ties/invalid pairs explicitly

allergen_constraint_preservation_fractio.definition: Substitutions that preserve all declared allergen exclusions and evidence gates divided by proposed substitutions.
allergen_constraint_preservation_fractio.denominator: all proposed substitutions including abstentions; false-safe is a hard failure

substitution_evidence_coverage_fraction.definition: Consequential substitutions with source, unit, quantity, role, and critical process evidence divided by consequential substitutions.

cook_agency_scale.definition: Participant-reported ability to set goals, understand recommendations, change/decline assistance, and retain final control.
cook_agency_scale.denominator: consenting participants; scale, anchors and subgroup reporting preregistered

independent_skill_retention_fraction.definition: Relevant tasks correctly completed independently after assistance withdrawal divided by comparable independent baseline skill attempts.
independent_skill_retention_fraction.denominator: matched tasks/participants; adjust for learning and task difficulty, not only self-report

voluntary_adoption_fraction.definition: Eligible participants who voluntarily choose to use the assistance again after a trial.
voluntary_adoption_fraction.denominator: eligible participants who had a real opt-in choice; report non-adoption and reasons

cultural_provenance_coverage_fraction.definition: Recipe/source/community knowledge used in consequential outputs with required provenance/attribution/permission status documented.
cultural_provenance_coverage_fraction.denominator: all consequential sourced culinary elements; public availability does not imply permission

accessibility_task_success_fraction.definition: Completed tasks among participants in a declared accessibility or experience cohort under an agreed protocol.
accessibility_task_success_fraction.denominator: all eligible attempts within each cohort; never report only an aggregate

uncertainty_and_missingness_coverage_fra.definition: Expected outcome fields with either valid evidence and uncertainty or an explicit missing/blocked/unknown disposition.
uncertainty_and_missingness_coverage_fra.denominator: all expected outcome fields across all trials

resource_boundary_completeness_fraction.definition: Declared in-scope water, energy, mass and cost streams actually measured or explicitly statused.

measured_no2_1h_ppbv.definition: Measured one-hour nitrogen dioxide concentration for a preregistered occupied zone during the stated cooking/idle interval.
measured_no2_1h_ppbv.denominator: each declared occupied zone × measurement hour; preserve high-exposure intervals and monitor location
measured_no2_1h_ppbv.notes: Select acceptance thresholds from applicable local occupational/environmental guidance with qualified review. U.S. study/reference values are context, not default South African legal limits.

thermal_exposure_degree_minutes_above_pr.definition: Time-integrated occupied-zone temperature exposure above a threshold declared in the protocol and justified for the target worker/task.
thermal_exposure_degree_minutes_above_pr.denominator: each declared worker zone × observed task/shift interval
thermal_exposure_degree_minutes_above_pr.notes: The threshold is study- and jurisdiction-specific; report raw temperature time series too.

air_quality_sensor_coverage_fraction.definition: Valid calibrated sensor-time records for required zones/intervals divided by all preregistered zone-time records.
air_quality_sensor_coverage_fraction.denominator: all planned location × time windows; missing or invalid readings remain visible
air_quality_sensor_coverage_fraction.notes: Coverage is a data-quality gate, not evidence that the zone was safe.

composite_score_policy.reason: A universal weighted score obscures hard safety gates, cultural context, skill, and genuine preference trade-offs.
composite_score_policy.allowed_alternative: Publish metric-wise Pareto sets for candidates that pass gates; if context-specific scalarization is requested, publish weights, sensitivity, hard constraints and affected-user approval.
